#!/bin/sh
out=''
while [ $# -gt 0 ]; do
  if [ "$1" = --output-dir ]; then out="$2"; fi
  shift
done
mkdir -p "$out"
case "$out" in
*/r1/cold-read/1/export)
printf '%s\n' '{"config":{"enable_mcp":false,"enabled_tools":["read_file"],"include_project_context":false,"outside_workdir":"deny"},"cost_usd":0.002,"usage":{"input_tokens":1200,"cached_input_tokens":200,"output_tokens":300}}' > "$out/export.json"
printf '%s' '[{"type":"message","role":"user","content":[{"text":"q"}]},{"type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"text":"Here is what I read.\n```json\n{\"decided\":\"  Use Postgres.\\n\",\"rejected\":\"\\tMongo, for joins.\",\"revisit\":\"Never  \"}\n```\nDone.\n"}]}]'
printf '%s' '' >&2
exit 0
;;
*/r1/cold-read/2/export)
printf '%s\n' '{"config":{"enable_mcp":false,"enabled_tools":["read_file"],"include_project_context":false,"outside_workdir":"deny"},"cost_usd":0.002}' > "$out/export.json"
printf '%s' '[{"type":"message","role":"user","content":[{"text":"q"}]},{"type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"text":"Here is what I read.\n```json\n{\"decided\":\"Append-only events.\",\"rejected\":\"\",\"extra\":1}\n```\nDone.\n"}]}]'
printf '%s' '' >&2
exit 0
;;
*/r1/cold-read/3/export)
printf '%s\n' '{"config":{"enable_mcp":false,"enabled_tools":["read_file"],"include_project_context":false,"outside_workdir":"deny"},"usage":{"input_tokens":0,"output_tokens":0}}' > "$out/export.json"
printf '%s' '[{"type":"message","role":"user","content":[{"text":"q"}]},{"type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"text":"Here is what I read.\n```json\n{\"decided\":\"x\"}\n```\nDone.\nHere is what I read.\n```json\n{\"decided\":5}\n```\nDone.\n"}]}]'
printf '%s' '' >&2
exit 0
;;
*)
exit 9
;;
esac
